## Type of change

Please select all applicable options.

Changes visible to end users of Oxiplate:
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `docs`: Updated documentation
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement

Changes **only** visible to Oxiplate developers:
- [ ] `build`: Build-related change
- [ ] `ci`: CI change
- [ ] `style`: Code style update
- [ ] `refactor`: Refactor
- [ ] `test`: Updated tests

## Leave PR as a draft until these are all true

- [ ] This was [made by a human][] with nothing generated by AI
- [ ] Tests have been added/updated for any code changes
- [ ] Book has been added/updated for user-facing changes
- [ ] CI passes (or `just dev` and `just book-tests` if CI isn't running automatically)
- [ ] I self-reviewed the changes

[made by a human]: https://0b10011.io/oxiplate/made-by-humans.html
